digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified CI pipeline on GitHub Actions
propositions: macOS CI execution time grew from 15–20 minutes to 30–40 minutes; pytest execution alone increased 14m31s due to 4.1k additional tests and expensive test mechanics
Several unit tests wait on real production timeouts, sleep calls, or retry backoffs that are not required for coverage and consume 121s, 25s, 25s, 15s, and 84s respectively in isolation
wiki corpus cache at process level under xdist generates per-worker recomputation; macOS aggregate wiki call time increased from 321.6s to 495.6s across runs
mutation testing addition correlates with observation window but does not extend critical path in 62 post-mutation runs and is not the root cause of the 14m31s regression
organization-level GitHub runner contention amplifies deterministic test work; macOS queueing increased from median 0.72m to 13.53m p90 across sample
seven linked remediation tickets address specific fixtures, sleepers, caches, and retry boundaries without reducing coverage, parallelism, or aggregate runner consumption
